checks.name: Same-UUID middle replacement updates child transforms without changing array endpoints
New parent UUID inserted in the middle is resolved; removed parents fall back locally
World runtime invalidation cannot retain a replaced parent object
Reordering and cycle prevention use current parent membership
Mirrored hierarchy point conversions and reparenting preserve the existing TRS contract
Unchanged parent lookups reuse the prepared index instead of scanning every entity
Actual prefab override reset updates children and survives undo/redo and serialization
